headword: {出席停止|しゅっせきていし}
gloss: suspension from attending school; mandatory absence

definitions.gloss: suspension from attending school; mandatory absence
definitions.explanation: A school's order that a student must stay home, typically because of an infectious disease (flu, measles, COVID-19) or as a disciplinary measure. Distinct from voluntary sick leave — the student is not allowed to attend.

examples.japanese: インフルエンザで{出席停止|しゅっせきていし}になった。
examples.english: I was suspended from school due to the flu.

examples.japanese: {出席停止|しゅっせきていし}{期間|きかん}は{欠席|けっせき}{扱|あつか}いにならない。
examples.english: The suspension period does not count as an absence.

examples.japanese: {学校保健安全法|がっこうほけんあんぜんほう}に{基|もと}づき、{校長|こうちょう}が{出席停止|しゅっせきていし}を{命|めい}じることができる。
examples.english: Based on the School Health and Safety Act, the principal can order a suspension from attendance.

notes:
Compound of {出席|しゅっせき} (attendance) + {停止|ていし} (stoppage). A formal school term — the student is legally barred from attending, most often to prevent the spread of an infectious disease.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {出席停止|しゅっせきていし}になる: to be put on attendance suspension
- {出席停止|しゅっせきていし}{期間|きかん}: suspension period
- {出席停止|しゅっせきていし}を{命|めい}じる: to order suspension from school

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {欠席|けっせき}: absence — general term, may be voluntary
- {停学|ていがく}: suspension — used at the high school/university level, often disciplinary
- {休校|きゅうこう}: school closure — the whole school closes, not just one student
